what: half a slot (r 3, centres 14 apart; the segment before the axis edge comes back to the axis along an arc) revolved 180 deg about its centreline
method: the profile lies on one side of the axis, so a turn of theta gives theta / 2 pi of the capsule (cylinder r 3, length 14 plus two hemispheres, 508.94): V = 1/2 of it; faces: the cylinder part, two spherical parts and one flat face = 4 (the two end faces of a half turn lie in the one plane through the axis and form a single stadium-shaped face).
